title: FRANCHISE & Stall Partnerships
sub: Own a profitable, turnkey sugarcane juice business with full brand training and farm supply support.

pillars.title: TURNKEY MOBILE COUNTER
pillars.desc: Complete rustic wooden stall, heavy-duty commercial stainless steel extractor, and branded POS setup.

pillars.title: PREMIUM CANE SUPPLY
pillars.desc: Guaranteed steady supply of freshly harvested, high-yield premium sugarcane stalks delivered to your hub.

pillars.title: TRAINING & CERTIFICATION
pillars.desc: Hands-on operational training, health & hygiene compliance, recipe mastery, and customer service excellence.

pillars.title: HIGH MARGINS & QUICK ROI
pillars.desc: Low ingredient cost, high consumer demand, zero waste byproduct utilisation, and strong event catering margins.

steps.title: EXPRESS INTEREST
steps.desc: Submit your application and schedule an initial discovery call.

steps.title: LOCATION & PLAN
steps.desc: Review territories, pitch locations (markets, malls, mobile event vans).

steps.title: SETUP & TRAINING
steps.desc: Receive your branded machinery, stock, and complete training.

steps.title: GRAND LAUNCH
steps.desc: Open your stall with our marketing support and start pouring fresh cane juice.
